Wav2Lip Open-Source Usage Notice
================================

The Wav2Lip open-source project states that results from its open-source code
or demo may be used only for research, academic, and personal purposes, and
that commercial use is prohibited because its models are trained on LRS2.

This notice is a summary, not a replacement for the upstream terms. Review the
current upstream project and the licenses for every code, model, weight, and
dataset artifact before use or redistribution:

https://github.com/Rudrabha/Wav2Lip

Nova Avatar classifies its bundled Wav2Lip integration as Research /
Non-commercial. It must not be used in or bundled with a commercial release.
